name: images_generate
title: Generate Image
description: Generate images, or rework one via references. NOT pixel-preserving: an edit that must keep the rest intact routes to a dedicated tool first — sharpness/quality: `images_upscale`; free space/extend canvas/new ratio keeping content: `images_expand`; one region: `images_retouch`; crop/exact pixels: `images_crop`/`images_resize`. No refs=TTI. references[] (max 12; see field docs). Output is opaque unless `transparentBackground` is set on a model that supports it; otherwise chain `images_remove_background` after. Defaults: mode=auto, ratio=1:1, count<=8. resolution/quality/variant/tier per images_models_list. UI clients: after generating, MUST call `creations_show` with all identifiers; never stop at links.

prompt.description: Prompt. With brandKitId, keep it SHORT: topic plus the user's hard constraints only (`no text`, `logo top right`). Kit and template own look — do not invent lighting, composition, typography, or a cinematic centerpiece, and do not restate brand identity. A library reference (character/product/locations) may be mentioned as `@<name>` (its library_list `name`) where it appears in the scene; the server rewrites the token into the reference description.

brandKitId.description: Brand kit sqid (the `id` from brand_kit_list/brand_kit_get). When set, the image is generated on-brand with Magnific One: brand palette, logo, typography and reference imagery are applied automatically. Do not restate identity in the prompt. A kit sent with another model is switched to Magnific One automatically — tell the user when the response says so. Draft (`extraSettings.draft`) takes no kit. The finished image gets a brand check, read as `brandCheck` on creations_wait/creations_get; never call an image on-brand before that check is `ready`.

templateSlug.description: Content template `slug` from the kit (brand_kit_get.templates); requires brandKitId. Pass only if they asked for that format. Applies that content type's recipe; the prompt stays short.

logoVariant.description: Logo mark `sqid` from brand_kit_get.logo_marks; requires brandKitId. Pins that mark for this generation only. Omit to use the kit primary logo.

channel.description: What this image is FOR, so the kit's surface-scoped rules apply. Pass only when they said it; omit when unsure — a wrong surface applies rules the brand confined elsewhere. A format (youtube_thumbnail, youtube_banner, instagram_story, instagram_reel_cover, instagram_post, linkedin_banner_personal, linkedin_banner_company, linkedin_post, tiktok_video_cover, x_banner, x_post, facebook_cover, facebook_post, facebook_event_cover, pinterest_pin, og_image, luma_event) or a medium (digital, social, print, video, presentation, packaging, merch, ooh). A format also satisfies its medium, so `print` covers what no format does.

validationRunId.description: Brand Kit validation run id; pair with validationScenarioKey. The persisted scenario overrides generation args.

mode.description: Use `auto` unless the user named a model; then take its `slug` from images_models_list. Naming trap: Nano Banana 2 = `imagen-nano-banana-2-flash`; `imagen-nano-banana-2` is Nano Banana Pro. With brandKitId the server always generates with `magnific-one` (Brand Kit only works with it) and returns `modelSwitched` when another mode was sent; never suggest another model for a branded image.

customModelId.description: Picker identifier from images_models_settings when required by the selected model.

type.description: image = any photo you have, incl. of a person/product to keep consistent. character/product/locations = pre-built library asset, never a creation. style = library LoRA, or a creation as style photo.

identifier.description: creation identifier for image/style-photo; numeric `id` from library_list for character/product/locations/style-LoRA. Never a raw upload id or URL: import a URL with `creations_upload_image`, a local file with `creations_request_upload` + `creations_finalize_upload`.

count.description: 1..8. N variants of ONE prompt = one call with count=N, never N separate calls.

seed.description: Same seed + same settings reproduce a result. Omit for a random one. With count>1 each variant uses seed+index. Read back as `seed` in `creations_get`.

resolution.description: Supported values per model — see `images_models_list.resolutions`. Omitted values use the model default.

quality.description: Supported values per model — see `images_models_list.qualities`. Omitted values use the model default.

variant.description: Submodel, e.g. gpt-2-mini `flare`|`sunburst`. See `images_models_list.variants`; dropped on a model without variants.

tier.description: Submodel quality tier, e.g. recraft-v4-1 `mid`|`pro`. Affects cost. See `images_models_list.tiers`.

transparentBackground.description: Alpha background. Only models flagging `transparentBackground` in images_models_list; elsewhere chain `images_remove_background`.

extraSettings.description: Model-specific. Keys/values via images_models_settings. Needs explicit mode. `magnific-one`: `draft` for an exploration grid.

draftTileIdentifier.description: Make a Draft tile final: its creation identifier (creations_wait results.tiles). mode=magnific-one, no extraSettings.draft. Send the Draft's prompt unchanged to keep the tile's style and framing; edited text is used as written.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project. Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

partialFailure.description: Some outputs queued, the rest stopped here.
